text.feels_intro: How {name}'s arrow wounds feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: an arrow has grazed {his} cheek or brow, leaving a thin, bleeding furrow.
{name}'s face: a deep, round arrow wound near the cheekbone, ragged where the shaft was torn out; blood has run down {his} jaw and the skin around it is swelling. It smells of fresh blood.

{name}'s face: an arrowhead is still buried in the bone, the broken shaft jutting from {his} cheek or brow; blood streams down {his} face and {he} is deathly pale. The thick iron smell of blood surrounds {him}.
body: {name}'s back: an arrow has nicked {him}, a small torn hole weeping a thin line of blood.
{name}'s back: a round, deep arrow wound in the torso, the shaft snapped off short or pulled out; dark blood soaks {his} clothing around it. The coppery smell of blood seeps from it.

{name}'s back: an arrow is sunk deep between the ribs, fletching still quivering with each breath; blood pulses around the shaft and {his} breathing is wet and shallow. {name} smells of blood, heavy and metallic.
arm: {name}'s {part}: an arrow has scored the skin, a shallow, bleeding gash.
{name}'s {part}: an arrow wound through the muscle, a torn hole where the shaft went in, blood running steadily down to the hand. A coppery tang of blood rises from it.

{name}'s {part}: an arrow is driven clean through the arm, the head out one side and the fletching out the other; blood pours and the limb hangs useless. The smell of fresh blood is strong around {him}.
leg: {name}'s {part}: an arrow has grazed the thigh or calf, a shallow, bleeding score.
{name}'s {part}: a deep arrow wound in the thigh, the shaft broken off or torn out, blood running down into {his} boot. It gives off the metallic tang of blood.
{name}'s {part}: an arrow is buried deep in the thigh, the broken shaft grinding against the bone; the leg buckles under any weight. The air around {him} is thick with the smell of blood.

head: {name}'s face stings sharply along the graze. {name} is startled and wary, touching it and flinching at the blood.
{name}'s face throbs hot and deep where the arrow went in. {name} is shaken and angry, keeping {his} head low and still.
{name}'s face is blinding pain around the arrowhead lodged in the bone; {he} is sick and dizzy. {name} is terrified and can hardly speak.
body: {name}'s back stings sharply where the arrow nicked it, catching on every breath. {name} is tense and watchful.
{name}'s back throbs deep inside around the arrow wound and every breath stabs. {name} breathes shallowly and moves stiffly.
{name}'s back is a deep, spreading agony around the buried shaft; every movement drags it through flesh and breath is short and wet. {name} is frightened and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings along the graze. {name} protects it and flexes the hand to test it.
{name}'s {part} throbs hard around the arrow wound and goes weak when gripping. {name} cradles it.
{name}'s {part} is burning agony around the shaft through it and will not respond. {name} is in shock and cannot grip anything.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings with each step where the arrow grazed it. {name} is wary, testing the weight.
{name}'s {part} throbs deep around the arrow wound and stabs when loaded. {name} limps and winces.
{name}'s {part} is excruciating; the arrowhead grinds in the muscle and the leg buckles when {he} tries to stand. {name} is panicked and needs help to move.

levels: , the point punching in with a hard thud. The shaft quivers in the flesh and {name} gasps as the pain blooms hot around it.
, the arrowhead tearing in beside a wound that is already bleeding. {name} staggers, the fletching jerking with each breath, and the pain flares sharp and nauseating.
, and the arrow sinks deep into the torn flesh. Blood runs freely around the shaft and {name} chokes on a cry. The smell of blood is suddenly thick.
, and it is too much. The arrow drives deep and the shock is crushing and cold; {name} goes ashen, {name}'s breath rattles and {name}'s knees give.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

start_unhurt.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. With no wounds to mend, it simply washes over {obj}, warm and soothing.
start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

no_attacker_hit.again: is struck by arrow after arrow

head: the arrow takes {name} in the eye and buries itself deep in the skull, the fletching jutting from the ruined socket. {name}'s head snaps back, the body stiffens and falls, blood and clear fluid running down {name}'s cheek.

the arrow punches through {name}'s throat and out the back of the neck; blood bubbles around the shaft and from {name}'s mouth with every failing breath. {name} claws at the arrow, choking on the iron taste, and dies in a wet, rattling gasp.
body: the arrow drives between {name}'s ribs and into the heart, the shaft standing out of the chest; blood spurts around it and froths pink at {name}'s lips. {name} stares down at it, gasping, and folds to the ground as the hot smell of blood spreads.
the arrow sinks to the fletching in {name}'s back and pierces the lungs; {name} pitches forward, coughing red, and drowns slowly in {name}'s own blood until the last wet breath rattles out.
arm: the arrow tears through {name}'s {part} and opens the great vessel inside; blood jets out around the shaft in bright spurts with every heartbeat. {name} clutches at it, screaming, until {name}'s grip slackens and {name} slumps dead in a red pool.

the arrow pins {name}'s {part} at the shoulder and drives on into the chest; the arm hangs useless while blood pours from both holes. {name} falls gasping, {name}'s cries thinning to whimpers as the coppery smell of blood fills the air.
leg: the arrow buries itself in {name}'s {part} and cuts the great vessel in the thigh; blood spurts around the shaft in a hot fountain and pools fast beneath {name}. {name} collapses screaming, then turns pale and shaking, and bleeds out in the thick iron reek of {name}'s own blood.

the arrow takes {name} high in the {part} at the groin; dark blood floods {name}'s clothing and runs over the ground. {name} crawls a little way, dragging the shaft, and dies there in a widening red pool that smells of blood and fear-sweat.

soil: As {name}'s body goes slack, the stink of {name}'s shit and piss mixes with the blood.
In death {name}'s bowels and bladder let go, and the stench of shit and piss joins the smell of blood.
